longName: Submit the Annual IDEA Part B Child Count and Educational Environments Federal Data Package
scope: The SEA's annual federal submission of the FS002 data file, FS5003 metadata, and FS5002 metadata via EDPass, through to acknowledged Submitted status for all three. Out of scope: LEA-level collection; OSEP review beyond first acknowledgement.
frequency: Annually, per SEA. 60 Part B reporting entities. Deadline ~April 1 of the following year.

actors.role: Federally-named accountable EDPass interface; drives the cycle, uploads, resolves errors, submits.
actors.interest: A clean cycle ending in Submitted with no late corrections.

actors.actor: SEA IDEA Part B Data Manager
actors.role: Reviews aggregation outputs; signs off on data accuracy; drafts data-note rationale.
Approves FS5002/FS5003 methodology; arbitrates methodology-change decisions.
actors.interest: Methodology reflects current policy and survives year over year.

actors.role: Receives the submitted package; reviews; may return it.
actors.interest: A clean, well-noted submission cleared without bouncing back.

actors.role: Runs cross-file BRSI rules; reports results; acknowledges Submitted; routes to OSEP.

interestedParties.interest: Counted accurately and categorized to reflect educational reality.

interestedParties.party: U.S. Office of Special Education Programs (OSEP)

interestedParties.interest: A traceable submission record and audit trail of data notes.

triggeredBy.name: The annual federal FS002 submission deadline approaches

assumes.statement: The SEA has an EDFacts Coordinator with active EDPass access, and the SSP identifies FS002/FS5003/FS5002 as required and scheduled.
EDPass is operational for the submission window.

story.action: confirms the State Submission Plan lists FS002, FS5003, and FS5002 as required and on schedule
story.intention: the cycle scope is correct before work begins

story.action: initiates FS002 Compilation to produce the year's data file
initiates FS5003 Confirmation to confirm/update the environments methodology responses
story.intention: the interpreting metadata is current and signed off

story.action: confirms/updates the FS5002 IDEA Child Count metadata responses
uploads the FS002 data file to EDPass; EDPass runs cross-file BRSI rules against the upload combined with the methodology responses and reports results
resolves business-rule errors by correcting data, adjusting methodology responses, or attaching a data note drafted with the Data Manager
story.intention: every rule passes or has an accepted note

story.action: confirms all three components are at Ready to Submit
story.intention: nothing is left in an error or draft state
the single authorized act that completes the federal record
story.benefit: the federal record for the school year is complete and internally consistent in one cycle

story.action: acknowledges Submitted across FS002, FS5003, FS5002 and routes to the OSEP State Lead
story.intention: the package enters OSEP's review queue

scenario.condition: FS002 Compilation returns failure (LEA aggregation, format, schema)

story.action: addresses the cause with the Data Manager and re-invokes the child case; resume at step 2

scenario.condition: methodology-change requirements surface needing SEA policy review

story.action: coordinates with the Policy / SpEd Director; responses are updated; resume
corrects format and retries; if EDPass is unavailable, opens a PSC Helpdesk ticket

scenario.condition: EDPass returns Errors on cross-file BRSI rules

story.action: reviews the DQ Results page, corrects the relevant component and re-uploads, or proceeds to step 6 to attach data notes
story.intention: cross-file rules pass or are noted

story.action: notifies PSC and the OSEP State Lead; the SSP is updated; late submission proceeds under exception protocol
story.intention: the cycle's state is never silently stale

scenario.condition: OSEP review identifies new quality issues and returns the package

story.action: addresses the issues and resubmits within the OSEP window

valueDriver.title: Federal IDEA Section 618 Compliance
valueDriver.motivation: The SEA must discharge its mandatory Section 618 reporting obligation on time and in valid form.

valueDriver.title: Longitudinal Comparability
valueDriver.motivation: Counts must be comparable year over year; methodology drift silently corrupts trend analysis.

valueDriver.title: Auditable Provenance
valueDriver.motivation: A reproducible trail from each federal number back to source, methodology, and any deviation.

valueDriver.title: Accurate Representation of Children with Disabilities
valueDriver.motivation: Each child counted once and categorized to reflect educational reality.

condition.statement: FS002, FS5003, and FS5002 all carry Submitted status in EDPass within the federal deadline.
Every applicable BRSI rule has passed or carries an accepted data note.
On failure or abort, each component is left in a known intermediate EDPass status -- never partially or ambiguously submitted -- and the Coordinator can resume.
No Submitted-status mismatch persists between FS002 and FS5003 after any re-upload; cross-file business-rule integrity is preserved.

relatedUseCases.notes: produces the FS002 data file uploaded in step 5
confirms the methodology combined with the upload in step 5
